fee_notes: All fees paid weekly on Tuesday basis. Royalty: 6% of Gross Sales with $150/week minimum. Marketing Fund: greater of 2% of Gross Sales or $50/week. Contact Center Fee: tiered from $50–$220/week based on operational stage, max $770/week. Technology Fee: $210/week. Accounting & Advisory: $85/week. Additional fees: Non-Compliance ($1,000–$4,000 per violation), Late/Insufficient Funds ($100 + 1.5% monthly), Renewal (25% of then-current franchise fee or $15,000), Transfer ($20,000 or actual expenses), Annual Convention (varies; $2,000 if not attending), Advertising Cooperative (up to 2% annually), Enforcement costs, Indemnification, and Warranty-related fees.
